svg.title: The omx family: omxapp + omxcore
svg.desc: The omx family: omxapp (UI, built once: native on Linux, macOS, iPhone, Android and the web) over omxcore (the data engine: SQL, joins, streaming; CPU and GPU; this repo) over your files (CSV and Parquet: open formats; nothing to import or convert). A full stack for data apps with no Python and no server: the app and its engine compile into one native binary. omxplorer is the first app built this way.
